text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan congratulates Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu over the Hebron accord.
- Cabinet meeting discusses strategy to protect workers against the use of asbestos.
- Police arrests gang charged with forging documents for immigrants bound for Europe and Arab countries.
- Seventy jobless graduates stage sit-in in a union headquarters to press for jobs.
- Morocco's state body in charge of water for drinking (ONEP) considers increasing bills to sanction those who waste water.

- Morocco pursues talks with businesses, the European Investment Bank and the European Union to devise programme to upgrade the economy so that it meets requirements of the free trade zone with the EU.
- Revenue from privatisation stood at more than 10 billion dirhams ($1.1 billion). This figure should not hide the need to review procedures which have delayed the initial programme.
